Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

lazer 0.1.0

  • First version. The readers and writers move here from daos: read_files(), read_workbook(), inspect_excel(), write_excel() and read_access(). lazer is independent of daos and expectr.

  • read_workbook() reads every sheet of an Excel workbook into a named list, finding the table on each sheet instead of reading every non-empty cell: titles, source notes and stray comments are left out, and one warning lists what was left behind. Choose the area yourself with range, one per sheet if needed, or a named range from the workbook (range = "Sales"), or read defined Excel tables by name with table. A password-protected workbook gives a clear error.

  • inspect_excel() lists the blocks of cells outside the table as a tibble, empty when the layout is clean.

  • read_files() is quiet on success and reports problems together: CSV files no longer print the locale and column specification for every file; a file that fails to read no longer stops the rest; unsupported extensions are caught before anything is read; out = "bind" re-types only the columns whose types clash; and files that share a name give a warning, and an error with out = "unpack".

  • The functions for supply and use table files (SUT; TA files in Danish, tilgang-anvendelse) are one family for both layouts, replacing daos’s read_ta(), read_ta2(), write_ta() and write_ta2(). read_sut() recognises version 1 and 2 by itself, write_sut(version = ) writes either, and convert_sut() converts a file between them. Both layouts are one table each in the source, which reader and writer follow. Files are written byte for byte as before. read_sut() now checks number fields in version 1 too, and skips empty lines instead of reading them as a row of NA.

Developed by Daniel Madsen.
